customer_reply:
Hello,

Thank you for reaching out. Our refund policy (see KB‑POL‑001) allows refunds only within 30 days of the invoice date for unused subscription fees. Since the subscription fees you’re requesting a refund for cover the past six months, they fall outside of this window, and we are unable to issue a refund.

If you believe there are extenuating circumstances, a credit can be considered, but it requires approval from our Finance team. Please let us know if you’d like us to initiate that process, and we’ll coordinate with Finance on your behalf.

If you have any other questions or need assistance with your account, feel free to let us know.

Best regards,
Support Team
